set.body: Build the renderer-neutral 2D scalar-field plotting family in five ordered slices. One checked ScalarField2D representation feeds continuous-fill heatmaps, rectangular 2D bins, 2D KDE, marching-squares contour lines, and topology-aware filled contour bands. Public APIs use Scala 3 ADTs and smart constructors; numeric kernels stay portable and allocation-controlled; every slice must pass shared JVM and Scala.js oracle/metamorphic tests and add ggplot2 visual-QA comparisons where semantics align.
set.title: Epic: scalar-field plots — heatmaps, 2D density, and contours
